title: Winning Hand Scoring Practice
description: Game-style riichi mahjong scoring practice: work out the final score of a winning hand from its han and fu.
exitToast: You left Winning Hand Scoring Practice

question.title: 1. The question
question.caption: You see the hand and the conditions of the win: the round wind, your seat wind, the dora and more.

answer.title: 2. Your answer
answer.caption: {fields, select, hanFu {Choose the han, the fu and the score, then press Answer.} other {Choose a score and it is checked right away.}}

result.title: 3. The result
result.caption: Compare your answer with the correct one and review how the score is calculated.

board.title: The hand and the conditions of the win
board.description: The winning hand and its conditions: round wind, seat wind, dora and tsumo or ron. The score depends on all of them.

hint.title: Hint
hint.description: Shows the hand split into a pair and four sets. If you are unsure how to split the sets, open it before you answer.

yaku.title: Yaku
yaku.description: Choose every yaku this win has. Dora is not a yaku, so leave it out.

han.title: Han
han.description: Choose the han from the yaku and the dora together. From mangan up, choose the limit (mangan, haneman and so on) instead of a number of han.
han.descriptionExact: Choose the han from the yaku and the dora together. For a yakuman, choose Yakuman instead of a number of han.

fu.title: Fu
fu.description: Choose the fu. If the han you chose reach mangan or more, the fu do not change the score, so the field is turned off and you can skip it.
fu.descriptionRequired: Choose the fu. With this setting you answer the fu even from mangan up.

score.title: Score
score.description: {fields, select, hanFu {Choose the score from the han and the fu.} other {Choose the score from the hand and the conditions of the win. Your answer is checked as soon as you choose.}} For a non-dealer tsumo, choose the pair of payments from each non-dealer and from the dealer (300/500 means 300 from each non-dealer and 500 from the dealer). For a dealer tsumo, choose the “all” amount.

scoreInput.title: Switch the input style
scoreInput.description: The button to the right of the Score heading switches between tiles and a dropdown. The style you pick carries over to the next questions and to the settings.

submit.title: Answer
submit.description: Becomes available once every field is filled. In the review you can compare your answer with the correct one and check the fu breakdown.

reveal.title: I don't know
reveal.description: Shows the correct answer and its breakdown without answering. It is not counted in your results.

setup.requireHanFu: Also answer the han and fu
setup.exactHan: Answer 5 han or more as a number of han
setup.exactHanInfo: By default, you answer hands of 5 han or more by their limit: mangan, haneman, baiman, sanbaiman or yakuman. Turn this on to answer with the exact number of han instead, such as 7 han or 12 han (a yakuman is still answered as Yakuman).
setup.requireFu: Answer the fu even from mangan up
setup.yakuFilterNote: With several yaku selected, each question has at least one of them.
